rows.en: She doesn't know! Taeko doesn't know anything!
Wait! I'll tell you, just wait!
Taeko, no!
My father gave me a good-luck charm pouch. The blueprints are probably inside the pouch…
That's all I needed to hear. I have no more use for you! Hand it over!
H-here it is!
Hehehe… All right, good!
Nngh… Kikaider!?
Now that I have the blueprints… I've no more business here! Kikaider, we'll settle this another time!
Jiro, Jiro!?
Hold it there… Yours truly won't stand for anyone who lays a hand on women and children!

Hanpen!?

Was that guitar just now you, Hanpen?

Well, well… Hanpei Hattori, I've outdone myself.

Come, come, you two… Hanpei Hattori will see you to safety! Quick, let's run.
Please… don't kill me!
Silence, traitor!! Professor Gill's orders are to punish you!
Wait! I haven't betrayed anyone. I'll get the blueprints, I swear.
It's too late! Kaimen Green already has the blueprints!
What!? Then…
Your role is finished!

We put you close to Kikaider so we could use Mitsuko's feelings for him!

We figured she'd make her move for sure, desperate for the Conscience Circuit blueprints! We have no more use for you!

Wait! Please, wait!

Kikaider trusts me! If I take him fake blueprints… I can destroy Kikaider, too.

Nngh… Put a bomb in the charm pouch?

All right… but failure won't be tolerated! Clear? Understood?
Understood…
Right, let's finish off Kikaider and his lot! I'll show them the power of our Shadow!
Nngh… Damn Kikaiders! Not bad at all, are you? But don't count on a next time! Damn it…
Damn iiit… Something's wrong! This wasn't supposed to happen! Curse you, Kikaider!
I'm immortal! Kikaider, this fight's only just begun! I'll make you pay!
Kikaider, I'm sorry…
Violet Sazae… Were those… words of yours a lie?
Violet Sazae… Were those… words of yours a lie?
Why didn't you do as I told you?
Why didn't you do as I told you?

We… can never escape Professor Gill.

That's… my fate… as one of DARK's Destruction Squad.

What!?

You betray us again, Violet Sazae!?

Using the fake blueprints meant for Kikaider, the bomb-rigged charm pouch… on yourself! Unbelievable!

What!?

Violet Sazaeee! Hang in there! Hey!!

What!?

Violet Sazaeee! Hang in there! Hey!!
Ugh… Kikaider… what I… told you… was true… ugh…
Damn you… Shadow, DARK! What do you think androids are!? I won't forgive you!!
Damn you… Shadow, DARK! What do you think androids are!? I won't forgive you!!
Taaah!!
Mari!
Mari!
Hmph… Some "Operation: Kill" this is! What's this sorry mess?

Fool…

The operation is only now entering its final stage! Watch!
What do you mean? Explain yourself, Shadow Knight.
Fufufu… Zero-One's weakness is that he always sides with women and children!
This woman, Mari… is she an android? Has something been planted in Mari?

The third button on Mari's blouse…

When that button is undone, the special bomb planted inside Mari's body will go off in a huge explosion! Mari's entire body is a bomb!

That is why I sent out a female android for this operation.

And the reason I designed Mari as an android who would end up acting on humanity's side is for this very moment!

To make Zero-One, so weak against women and children, desperate to save Mari!

Switch on the agony circuit!
Agony circuit?
Ugh… it hurts… Aah… ugh… Noooo!!
Mari, hang in there!
Ichiro! Ugh… undo my buttons…

There… the first button! Next, the second button…

And the button after that is the special bomb's detonator!

Shadow Knight's remote switch makes the agony circuit inside Mari torment her with pain enough to kill…

Knowing nothing, Zero-One undoes the buttons, one, then another… Get away, Zero-One!! Throw that woman aside!
I'm sorry, Jiro…
Why didn't you do as I told you?
Forgive me, I…
Why didn't you trust me?
I'm worried about you and Masaru!
And I'm worried about you, Jiro…

That's different!

That's… because I'm an android the doctor built.

And it's fine for it to stay incomplete! If my Conscience Circuit were ever made complete…

I'd become a machine beyond humans. I want to stay as close as I can to you and Masaru, Mitsuko.

Wait, Jiro! I'm sorry! Jiro!!

Father… Father, where are you? Come home soon and tell me!

I've fallen for Jiro… What should I do?

Father… is it wrong for a woman to worry about the one she loves more than anything?

No matter what, I want to make Jiro's Conscience Circuit complete for him!

Jirooo!!
I'm better now…
Ah, Mari! Wait, Mari!!
Androids who came to know suffering and inner conflict precisely because they came to know the human heart. The answer they reached as humans brought about an all too tragic end.
But Ichiro and Jiro strove to help each other to the very last. And through that, they found a single ray of hope in the battle.

If only androids that knew nothing but destruction as enemies could be fitted with a Conscience Circuit, they should be able to understand one another… A path to a peaceful resolution of this battle had come into view, if only faintly.
The Kikaider brothers felt an indescribable rage toward Shadow, the new organization scheming evil!
Defeat Red-Face Turtle and all Shadowmen!
Defeat Hell Kappa and all Shadowmen!
Hold out until Hakaider leaves to have his brain's blood replaced!
Hold out until Hakaider leaves to have his brain's blood replaced, and defeat all Androidmen!
Defeat all Androidmen!
Defeat all Shadow Robots and DARK's Destruction Squad!
Ichiro is defeated
Jiro or Ichiro is defeated, or Hakaider is destroyed

uncertain: U04653: Mitsuko's 知らないわ read as speaking for Taeko ('She doesn't know!').
U04663/U04665: Hanpei's archaic 拙者 rendered 'Yours truly'; Mitsuko's nickname ハンペン kept as 'Hanpen'.
U04717: Jiro's reply to Mitsuko's unfinished 'I'm worried about you too'; the source logic is compressed, kept close.
U04721: subject is singular in spirit (androids like Violet Sazae and Mari); rendered plural.
U04729: garbled 葉て read as 全て.
U04732: 変型 read as a garbled 'or' connector (cf. B0034 通制と); rendered 'Jiro or Ichiro is defeated, or Hakaider is destroyed'.
